title: The US Federal Reserve's September meeting shows officials are increasingly citing surging AI investments, not tariffs, as the driver of rising goods inflation (Steve Thompson/Washington Post)
summary: Steve Thompson / Washington Post: The US Federal Reserve's September meeting shows officials are increasingly citing surging AI investments, not tariffs, as the driver of rising goods inflation — At their September meeting, Fed officials cited “surging AI-related investments” as a factor in inflation pressures. — Loading...
contentText:
Steve Thompson / Washington Post :

The US Federal Reserve's September meeting shows officials are increasingly citing surging AI investments, not tariffs, as the driver of rising goods inflation   —  At their September meeting, Fed officials cited “surging AI-related investments” as a factor in inflation pressures.  —  Loading...
